description: This file defines the core API for SQL Lab in Apache Superset, including functions for managing query editors, tabs, executing/canceling queries, and event listeners for query and tab actions.

classes.name: Tab
classes.description: Represents a query tab with associated metadata and editor getter.

classes.name: Panel
classes.description: Represents a UI panel, such as the active south pane tab.

classes.name: QueryContext
classes.description: Encapsulates context for a query execution, including tab info and options.

classes.name: QueryResultContext
classes.description: Contains detailed context for query results, including columns, data, and execution info.

classes.name: QueryErrorResultContext
classes.description: Provides context for query failures, including error messages and details.

classes.name: Database
classes.description: Represents a database connection with its properties.

methods.name: registerEditorHandle
methods.description: Registers an editor handle for a tab, resolving pending promises.

methods.name: unregisterEditorHandle
methods.description: Unregisters an editor handle for a tab.

methods.name: createEditorProxy
methods.description: Creates a proxy delegating to the current editor handle for hot-swapping editors.

methods.name: getEditorAsync
methods.description: Returns a promise resolving to the editor handle, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: makeTab
methods.description: Constructs a Tab object with given parameters.

methods.name: getTab
methods.description: Retrieves a Tab object by ID, if it exists.

methods.name: extractBaseData
methods.description: Extracts base parameters, SQL, and options from a query action.

methods.name: createQueryContext
methods.description: Creates a QueryContext from a start or stop query action.

methods.name: createQueryResultContext
methods.description: Creates a QueryResultContext from a successful query action.

methods.name: createQueryErrorContext
methods.description: Creates a QueryErrorResultContext from a failed query action.
